source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, cover page
source.quote: There were 1,708,029,668 shares of common stock outstanding as of November 11, 2026.

notes: One class of common stock, listed on the New York Stock Exchange as DIS. The FY2026 10-K cover (filed November 17, 2026) is the latest count; the most recent 10-Q is for the quarter ended June 27, 2026, so it is older.
